# Number One Ads

> Number One Ads (No.1 Tele Advertisers) is a 360° advertising agency based in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India, established in 2000. We provide end-to-end advertising, branding and signage — from creative design and digital marketing to large-format signage, ACP building elevation, exhibition stalls, roadshows and film production — with in-house design, fabrication and installation across Tamil Nadu.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2000 (25+ years)
- Location: Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Service area: Madurai and across Tamil Nadu / South India
- Contact: contact@no1ads.in
- Sister units: Triple A Signage (signage manufacturing), Infobus Advertising (transit/bus media)
- Network: Member of BNI Chanakyaas, Madurai

## Services
- [Creative Design](https://no1ads.in/services/creative-design): Brand-led print, outdoor and digital artwork.
- [Digital Marketing](https://no1ads.in/services/digital-marketing): Google, Meta, Spotify and connected-TV campaigns; social management.
- [Branding & Identity](https://no1ads.in/services/branding-identity): Logos, brand systems and guidelines.
- [LED Signage](https://no1ads.in/services/led-signage): Channel letters, glow signs and digital LED displays.
- [ACP Elevation](https://no1ads.in/services/acp-elevation): Aluminium composite panel building façades.
- [Signage Boards](https://no1ads.in/services/signage-boards): Name boards, directional and storefront signage.
- [Exhibition Stalls](https://no1ads.in/services/exhibition-stalls): Stall design, fabrication and on-site build.
- [Roadshow & Outdoor](https://no1ads.in/services/roadshow-outdoor): Roadshows, hoardings and transit media.
- [In-Shop Branding](https://no1ads.in/services/in-shop-branding): Retail interior and point-of-sale branding.
- [Printing](https://no1ads.in/services/printing): Offset, digital and large-format printing.
- [Film & Photography](https://no1ads.in/services/film-photography): TV commercials, brand films and product shoots.
